action.action-desc: Mr. Bacon introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Armed Services

form.official-title: To amend title 10, United States Code, to designate the National Guard Relief Foundation as a military welfare society for certain purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the National Guard Heritage Welfare Society Act.

section.header: Inclusion of National Guard Relief Foundation as a military welfare society for certain purposes

subsection.text: Section 2566(b)(1) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:
